component: Message menu context for synthetic and standalone views

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: InitMessageMenu treats a selected message's folder as real context even when its synthetic tab has no folder. Mark prefers that message folder and falls back to the tab folder; tag/move depend on a stored message. New synthetic and standalone tasks use mode-derived menu-state assertions through menus/head.js. They do not directly test mark/tag mutations or establish a fix for the separate read-state report.
title: Synthetic-message menus use the message folder when the tab has no folder
